english: Aren't we there yet?
It should be a little further ahead.
Still, a training lodge with its own hot spring...\nButei High is loaded.
We take all kinds of requests from civilians,\nand we have loads of graduates.
Using your connections is Butei basics.
Ah, I can see a building!\nIsn't that it?
Wow, what an unusual building.
Japanese-style architecture must be rare for you.
Um... thank you all so much.
What's this? So formal all of a sudden.
Humans fear elves.\nAnd yet you've all welcomed me\nso warmly...
A friend of a friend is a friend! That's what I say☆
The circle of friends, connected by phone!
...Sometimes you and Remu-san\nare perfectly in sync, desuu.
You two get along super well sometimes,\nyou and Remu-san, Teach!
Well, yeah!
We don't really know\nwhat elves are like, so\nmaybe that's for the best.
I'll do my best\nnot to be afraid of all of you, too.
All right, this old man'll\ndo his best to deepen our friendship tooo!\nC'mere c'mere, skinship skinship!
Ah! Mion-san!?
//SFX: boing boing
H-hey! Mion!\nWhat are you doing!
I'm pressing it against you! My arm. C'mon c'mon!
//SFX: boing boing
P-please, stop...
...Big sis.\nYou've been way too rowdy since Tiffania arrived.
Aria, say something to her!
What's wrong with it?\nThere's merely an object existing\nwhere there should be empty space.
Exactly.
Rip it off.
Um, [CLAUDE]-san,\nplease don't come over here.
(No way! Closer!)
(I'd get minced and then\nblown up, so I'm not going...)
//Scene change.\n//Background: hot-spring inn
Huh...?
There's a notice saying:\n'Closed for a few days. -The manager.'
Didn't you make a reservation!?
I took a look inside; there's nobody here.
It's closed?
There's an inn and a hot spring! No problem!\nWe'll just stay without asking!
That'd be fine if we had food.
Fufufu. What do you think\nI'm accompanying you on this trip for?
Oh! That face brimming with confidence!
There's mountains and a river nearby;\nwe can probably forage ingredients.
Then I'll go catch fish in the river!
I think I can help find ingredients.\nI lived in the forest, after all.
I can cook most things, so\nbring me anything\nthat looks edible!
If we think of it as survival,\nit's no big deal.
This'll make a great memory!
I'm going to check out the bath!
[MERU],\ngo clean the bath☆
Yes! Magical bath-cleaning, desuu!
[NOEL],\ngo clean the bath☆
Yeees! I'll wipe out any stainn!
Naturally, I'll be on cooking duty!
Cecilia's on bath duty too.
Honestly! I won't accept this!
//Fade to black; time passes (night falls).\n//Background: hot-spring inn.\n//Relaxing in the room after dinner.
That was quite the lavish spread.
You can manage with whatever ingredients\nyou have on hand, no?
Siesta-san's skills were splendid.\nBoth the prep and the seasoning.
I was amazed at how you filleted the fish, Shirayuki-san!\nYou must teach me!
So, who took down\nthat huge boar we put in the hot pot?
With magical hunter studies,\nit's a one-hit KO☆
I took it down clean with one hit to a vital spot,\nso we could eat every bit, right?
You really can do anything...
But y'know, now that it's dark,\nisn't this building kinda creepy?
It's pretty old.\nAnd there's nobody here but us...
Maybe it's one of those inns with a dark pastt.\nLike at night, while you're sleeping,\nthe guests vanish one by onee...
H-hey!?\nStop it! That kind of talk!
Is Cecilia-san bad with scary stories?
N-no, that's not true at all!
...But aren't we really missing someone?
Stop it, Aria-san!\nEven as a joke, that kind of thing...
No, I really feel like someone's missing...
Who's missing, desuu?
Who's missing?
Sorry, it's me...
Oh, it was you.\nI'd forgotten\nyou were even here.
I'd even forgotten you were alive.
I'd forgotten your very existence.
S-such cruelty...
(That's why I keep telling you\nto be greedier.)
So where were you, anyway?
I was looking around the building,\nand I found a strange place...
A strange place...?
//Scene change.\n//Background: cave
Huh, a cave?
Looks deep. Can't see the back.
Doesn't this get you a little excited?
You wanna explore it?
A test of courage before the hot spring.\nNot bad, huh?
I-I'm not going!?
Shion-san and I will\nstay behind to clean up after dinner.
Then I'll help clean up too.
Shall the rest of us go in?
Let's go! It's an expedition!
//Scene change.\n//Background: cave.\n//The group cautiously advances through the dark cave.
I-it's quiet...
This light's too dim; I can barely see ahead.
That's what makes it thrilling!
This is, however...
We charged in on momentum, but...
It's scarier than I imagined, desuu...
Kinda scary, actually. Haha...
...Everyone. Shall we go back?
What, Shirayuki? Scared?
I've got a bad feeling.\nEither way, I think we should go back.
I agree with Shirayuki-chan.\nThis place feels wrong.
W-what do you mean!?\nDon't say scary stuff!
Actually, I've been feeling it too.\nA strange air, or...
Eve-san, do you feel anything?
Hmm, let me see, I duuunno☆\nis what I'd like to say, but...
...Maybe we should go back?
What about Rin-san? She's awfully quiet...
H-huh? Rin-san?
Huh, she's gone?
She's just trying to scare us!\nRin! Answer me!
//Silence. (An awkward pause since Rin is gone.)
Did Rin-san really disappear?
Impossible!? Did she go ahead alone!?\nWhat are you doing, Rin!
//Houki runs off.
H-hey, Houki!?\nDon't just run off!
//SFX: running footsteps.\n//Fade to black.\n//Rin, Houki, Eve, [MERU], [NOEL], and Shirayuki are gone. A haze covers the screen, obscuring visibility, or something like that.
Wait, Houki!\nSheesh, how far did she run?
...H-huh?
Aria-chan, where's Houki-chan?
...No, I didn't catch up.\nIs everyone else here?
I'm here.
I'm here too.
I'm here too.
That's odd... [MERU]-san,\nand Eve-san aren't following.\nShirayuki-san seems to be missing too?
That's odd... [NOEL]-san,\nand Eve-san aren't following.\nShirayuki-san seems to be missing too?
Wait, who's here right now?\nMe, Remu, Louise, Tiffania, Sonico,\nand [CLAUDE]... just six of us?
That should be right.
Rin-chan, Houki-chan, Eve-san,\n[MERU]-chan,\nand Shirayuki-chan are missing?
Rin-chan, Houki-chan, Eve-san,\n[NOEL]-chan,\nand Shirayuki-chan are missing?
Only half of us are here!\nW-what's happening!?
Huh... what's wrong with me... I'm getting sleepy...
My head's going fuzzy too...
Huh!? Could that be...?\nRemu-san, isn't that it?
//Silence. Remu has vanished.
Huh... Remu-san?\nShe was just here, right?
Aria-san! Remu-san was here, right!?
//Silence. Nobody's left.
No way... Aria-san?
Louise-san! Tiffania-san!\nSonico-san...!!
Nobody... here...?
I'm here.
Huh?
//[CLAUDE] appears. (A fake created by illusion.)
M-me!?
Welcome to the world of nightmares.
Ahahahahahahahaha!!!
H-hieee!!!
//[CLAUDE] is dragged in as the screen fades to black.
Ugh... where is this?
H-huh?\nEveryone's here...? Are you okay!?
Don't know about 'okay,' but...
For now, it looks like everyone's here.
Fufufufu...
//Black Louise appears deep in the cave.
W-what's that!? A black me!?
Found you... Louise...
//A large number of grunt units appear.
W-where did they come from!?
Are these enemies!?
This shoot has horror elements too!?\nEven knowing that, it's scary!
Strange... I sense no life in them...
Is this the power of dreams?\nBut when did it...?
Let's just beat them up!!
No other choice!
Fufufufu...
Just what is that thing...?
//Battle start.
Yes! We got one!
//The defeated grunt reappears in a different spot.
Impossible! That's the one we just beat!?
It's a trick! It has to be!
A trick...? That's it, I get it!
This is all an illusion!\nAn illusion created by the black me!
You mean the one over there?
Yes! If she uses the same magic as me,\nshe can create endless illusions!\nHit the real body casting the magic and they should vanish!
//Battle continues.\n//Defeat the grunts, then attack Black Louise.\n//She vanishes anticlimactically the moment she's hit once.
She vanished...?
D-did we do it?\nThat was anticlimactic...
//Black Louise appears in a different spot.
She appeared over there!?\nSo that was an illusion?
Fufufufu...
//Black Louise multiplies.
Th-they multiplied!?
Ahahahahaha!!!
W-what are we supposed to do about THIS!?
//Battle continues.\n//Several turns pass (defeat a few Black Louises?).
Tch, I can't tell which one's the real body...!\nAt this rate...
This really is a nightmare...!
What's wrong, I wonder...?
It seems she noticed something...
At a time like this... how meddlesome...
//The grunt units vanish.
Th-they're vanishing!?
Damn... I was so close...
//Black Louise vanishes.
The nightmare... is ending?
//Battle end.
Uugh...\nH-huh? Where is this...?
Inside the cave, right...
...What was that just now?\nDid it really happen?
The black me...\nShe was really there, right?
I saw the black Louise-san.\nAnd her splitting and multiplying too.
I saw her too!
Me too. So it was real?\nA whole group sharing the same dream\nis impossible, right?
No, it happens.\nIn the world of dreams, nothing is strange.
But honestly, I can't tell\nwhether that was really a dream,\nor an illusion created by that black Louise's magic.
And the biggest mystery is\nwhy this phenomenon ended.
It didn't feel like\nwe broke the dream or illusion.
Yeah. Like someone interrupted it...
But there's nobody here.\nNot even the black Louise.
That's true...
Um, everyone.
I'm sure there's lots of mysterious stuff\nand things bugging you, but\nfirst I want to say this.
What is it?
This cave... can we get out of here quick?
That's it!!
Let's soak in the hot spring, warm up,\nand forget allll about it!
No objections!
Nikoniko-chan's smart☆
Desuu!
As expected of a college student!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: cave (a different shot, or the entrance if available).
Shirayuki-chan? What's wrong?
I felt like someone was over there just now...
Huh?
Remu! Shirayuki! Hurry up!\nWe'll leave you behind!
Coming!\nRemu-san, let's not go any further.
Y-yeah...
//Remu and Shirayuki leave.\n//Background unchanged; a voice from afar.
Seriously, why did we go into\nsuch a creepy cave!?\nWhich idiot found it!?
Umm, who was it again?
You! You idiot!!
It's fine already.\nLet's soak in the hot spring and forget all about it!
//After the three voices, Dr. Shinigami emerges from the darkness.
...Fufu!
//END
